* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Effect: The Camp, Tatooine, C
|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/thecamp.html</ref>

This Effect puts the hurt on two annoying and dominant strategies in the game. With [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]] (from the DSII set), you can even start with it!

First, while you have [[The Camp]] out, your opponent will be less likely to activate a high amount of Force on turn 2 like in the past. No more camping at non-battleground docking bays with some cheap characters using the [[Imperial Arrest Order]] + [[Mobilization Points]] combo. If they want to, they must pay the price... occupy or control a battleground docking bay instead. Some will say that this will hurt decks like [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire{{!}}Ralltiir Operations]], but that deck worked fine without that combo, and note that it affects both players. This card puts the "Wars" back in Star Wars. :)

Second, this card mitigates the bonuses the Dark Side reaps with Scum And Villany. Alien base decks can still be popular but they won't get the nearly free deploy that they used to get. Most aliens will end up costing what is printed on the card, but they should stay far away from the Jedi since that is [[Maul]]'s and [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s department.
